verdicts.decision_note: The accepted Google Drive destination is artifact hand-off logistics, not an implementation-relevant behavior, interface, configuration, or artifact-content requirement.
Choosing between direct chat upload and a chat-posted link changes only hand-off logistics and does not modify implementation-relevant behavior.
Posting a file link is a delivery hand-off action, not runtime verification of an implementation-relevant product behavior.
Requesting direct chat delivery changes only hand-off logistics and does not affect software behavior, artifact content, configuration, or a qualifying acceptance condition.
Supplying a link instead of a direct upload is a hand-off-channel mismatch, not a runtime failure of implementation-relevant behavior.
